# Scope of round R15 — Fix shipping cost calculation at checkout

## Variant

condensed

## Requirements introduced

- RF-07 — The checkout shows the correct shipping cost for each region, including free-shipping promotions.

## Acceptance criteria

- The checkout shows the updated shipping cost immediately after the address is chosen.
- Free shipping (promotion FOX) appears for the SE region.
- The totals recalculate without reloading the page.

## Out of scope for this round

- International shipping.
